name: tabnav
description: A row of links to sibling pages, styled as tabs with the current page marked, that scrolls sideways when it is too narrow.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current link, its edge, and the hover fill.

attributes.name: data-emphasis
attributes.description: The current link is filled with the variant; without it the current link is underlined.

children.description: The links, one per li, with role="list", which keeps WebKit announcing it as a list once the markers are gone.
A page. The current one carries aria-current="page"; a tab for a section that holds the current page may carry aria-current="true".

tokens.name: --yeti-tabs-border
tokens.description: The rule along the bottom of the row.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of the rule; the current link's edge is twice it.

tokens.name: --yeti-radius-sm
tokens.description: Corner radius of the current link with data-emphasis="high".

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: How long a link takes to change color.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xl
tokens.description: How wide the fade is at an edge with more links beyond it, and the scroll padding that keeps the marked link clear of it.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-line
tokens.description: The default variant's line color for edges and underlines, when the primary has a brand color; the variant's color otherwise.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links in order, scrolling the row to bring each one into view.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label such as "Repository", since the page has at least one other nav. Put role="list" on the ul, which keeps WebKit announcing it as a list once its markers are gone. The current page's link carries aria-current="page"; a tab for a section that holds the current page may carry aria-current="true". These are links, not tabs: there is no tablist role, no arrow keys and no script. For panels that switch on one page, use tabs.

unguarded: scroll-initial-target (where missing, the row starts at its start)
guarded: animation-timeline: scroll() (fallback: no fade; the browser's own scrollbar, which is always there, is the only signal)
